chatam-sofer/2:_: (Same author seif 3 in hagahah and Terumat HaDeshen siman 114) note: and see my responsa; and see Chiddushei Chatam Sofer Orach Chayyim siman 136.
eliyah-rabbah/1:_: They do not have much etc. — meaning it was a bit necessary for him to have leisure to release the Nile and to expel the swallow, as Taz wrote from his dog. And what he wrote in the dress etc.
eliyah-rabbah/2:_: And he did not come in etc. — meaning vessels used from outside like a bowl sometimes inverted on pot or drawn from pot should be brought into pot first and last; narrow vessel that cannot be scrubbed inside or has cracks — forbidden in hagalah.
eliyah-rabbah/3:_: It is better etc. — Maharil wrote to kasher three days before Pesach. He wrote followers book with Torah of the Holy One.
eliyah-rabbah/4:_: And so you need not etc. — and from Mateh Yehuda and High Court, Dougin wrote to kasher first useful and finally even fifth; and wrote one would kasher forbidden knife if sixty water against knife and not nullifying prohibition initially but to circulate knife — up to here; and from anywhere should not use hagalah water of pot.
eliyah-rabbah/6:_: If the vessel is not his son etc. — or I am afraid of him.
eliyah-rabbah/7:_: He will roll etc. — careful to take two pins (Mateh Moshe), or pour small sample of fish or basket.
eshel-avraham/1:א: Merking. And if he rests, he won’t get shot again. The Last:
eshel-avraham/1:ב: poisoned. For the lesson of our six-year-olds in the Rambam and Ramban, he added that he would see in a beautiful teaching, but he was a manipulated and fired as the world used to immediately and immediately put out the custom of the Torah:
eshel-avraham/5:_: Drink. And if you do not have a lot of bread, you will not be able to do it
eshel-avraham/7:_: In cold and enslaved water, there is no secret to the heat:
kaf-hachayyim/1:_: [Section A] should be careful to overcoat and so on, the order of the leaf takes a large fire full of water and boiling without waking up until the mountain rises across the entire vessel from all its pasts inside and out and entering it all the tools that want to benefit and bring one another. Dressed. And a large vessel that cannot be put in the shooter will see the Sileman and.
levushei-serad/3:_: With Ephraim who is cobbled with blasphemy etc. — D.C.
levushei-serad/4:_: A ski cheque that inserts vessel in another pot is not useful as captain — D.C.
rabbi-akiva-eiger/3:_: Magen Avraham does not return and reawaken because tastes divided — Mishna Berurah Lee Deddifadapa; even entering tools together in water with sixty against A.D. Dea prohibitions, Z.
ateret-zekenim/1:א: One should be careful to kasher etc. It appears that even if one kasher before the fifth hour, and even if the pot is not ben yomo, one must kasher the pot in which one kasher first and last — not as the Rosh; and so is the practice; do not forsake etc. And even in this leniency of the Rosh that before the time of prohibition one may kasher even ben yomo vessels even without sixty in the water because it is noten taam bar noten taam d'heter — it appears one should be stringent regarding leaving twenty-four hours, as Rabbeinu Yehuda, for since Semag wrote regarding fish that rose in a meat bowl that it is forbidden l'chatchila to cook them in a meat vessel to eat with milk — and similarly regarding chametz.
ateret-zekenim/1:ב: However many dispute etc. It is difficult regarding the words of the author of the hagahah, for this wording is from responsum of Geonim, and Beit Yosef wrote on it that it is not explained literally; and so in Terumat HaDeshen — see there; and Kol Bo wrote one must be careful that the large pot in which one kasher not cease boiling while vessels are inside etc.; and Beit Yosef wrote all this when one kasher after the time of prohibition, and on this he was silent here; nevertheless all agree hagalah does not help if water is not boiling — if so why did Rama write many dispute — requires study. Forbidden to libun a spit after six hours since chametz prohibition already applies — so in derash of Mahararash.
ateret-zekenim/2:_: Unless one of them is not ben yomo — this is Gemara's words. It appears to me if there is sixty against both then permitted; and one may not nullify prohibition l'chatchila; and one may say his intent is to fix the vessel and kasher it — so in responsum of Maharam; and one may say meat vessel and dairy vessel together even one after the other one may not kasher if both are ben yomo, even though the first is nullified in sixty — nevertheless it returns and reawakens — so too Rashba.
biur-halacha/1:א: So that one need not be precise etc. — see Mishna Berurah. Several Acharonim [Mateh Yehuda, Maamar Mordechai, Peri Chadash and others] questioned the Mechaber's words that imply after the time of prohibition one must be careful in all these — from the fifth hour until night; but truly this is not so — if it is not ben yomo or there is sixty in water one need not be careful at all in the other matters; what difference if one kasher two types of vessels or leaves them too long or other matters considered, since there is sixty or not ben yomo — even if absorption returned in the vessel it is noten taam bar noten taam d'heter; one cannot say the Mechaber meant only before fifth hour no care needed and after fifth hour care in some of them — sixty or not ben yomo or not leaving too long or water not ceasing boiling — for if ben yomo and no sixty to nullify expulsion, even if careful not to leave too long or water not ceasing — still forbidden per poskim [Rashba siman 463 and Tosafot] that always absorbs; and Gra in note 12 explained Mechaber wrote all for clarity and applies even to lenient views on these reasons alone when not ben yomo and no sixty since not leaving long and water did not cease — no absorption; nevertheless before five is better to kasher when no care needed at all; but for law no difference in these matters — even if careful they do not help after prohibition time; essence depends on sixty or not ben yomo — then even if left too long or water ceased afterward we do not care.
biur-halacha/1:ב: Must be careful in all etc. — see Taz who wrote another matter requiring care — not to kasher part of vessel twice, as above siman 451 seif 9, such as large vessels that cannot enter pot at once — do not rotate by hand in water lest return and insert water over part already kashered once and expelled all its expulsion, and now when returning to water it reabsorbs what already expelled; even if insert only half vessel and remove after expulsion and return other half and narrow so not insert one part twice — very difficult narrowing; and with tongs also impossible to be careful — therefore Taz advised kasher in net or perforated vessel so hagalah in one time, or sixty in water against vessel then expulsion nullified in water and even if reabsorbs no matter; but thereby cannot kasher many vessels in pot as today's custom where expulsions join and need sixty against all vessels [and another advice per Acharonim Mateh Yehuda and Maamar Mordechai: vessel not ben yomo is noten taam lifgam; and what Taz doubted that noten taam lifgam forbidden l'chatchila — they challenged him: only regarding pot that absorbed good taste initially then impaired; not so in hagalah where even if reabsorbs in vessel only impaired taste — and practice is lenient].
biur-halacha/1:ג: That one need not be careful in them etc. — Rama and Mechaber in this entire seif follow one view that while chametz is permitted it is noten taam bar noten taam d'heter and no care needed in anything; see Or U'Mussar, Peri Chadash, Biur HaGra that all this is per poskim who hold chametz is called heter taste; but per those who hold chametz is called prohibition taste — and Mechaber above siman 451 seif 4 ruled thus — then no difference between before fifth hour or whole day; see Peri Chadash who challenged poskim against each other; accordingly one of two matters I brought in Mishna Berurah — vessels not ben yomo or kasher large pot with sixty to nullify vessels kashered therein — is fundamental law requiring care even when kashering during permitted chametz time; and in our country where all city vessels kasher in one large pot, sixty cannot be against all vessels since all expulsions join as Magen Avraham wrote — therefore careful not to kasher any vessel unless passed twenty-four hours since chametz use; and some are stringent when wanting to kasher intestines from chametz to use them chametz three days prior [Maharil and Mateh Moshe].
chatam-sofer/1:_: Taz s.k. 11 — see general rules Pesach 52; and see Mishnah 10 chapter 5 of Machshirin; and see well Rambam chapter 7 Laws of Food Impurity halacha 2; and one may compare this to impurity — smoke rising from hot water as liquid is considered as Rambam wrote; and presumably also upper part anyway does not conduct chametz expulsion from lower with it upward as we find similarly regarding blood that does not percolate upward; therefore Taz was precise and wrote no prohibition except regarding impurity [and also noten taam bar noten taam d'heter — it appears there is custom to rely on this — see]. Within this enclosed section some words are missing; what is discernible we wrote between the two half-squares.
chokhmat-shlomo/1:_: Seif 1 in hagahah: if he did not kasher before prohibition time he may kasher until Pesach when chametz is in any amount etc. — see in my novellae to Yoreh De'ah siman 69 seif 11 what I proved there from Agur that there is room to permit kashering a vessel even during Pesach such as via irui and trickling flow — see there and examine.
eliyah-rabbah/5:_: But that they not cease boiling etc. — the reason is lest they return and absorb what they expelled as Beit Yosef wrote; and also that one not insert vessels until water boils — Beit Yosef forbids; and see Beit Yosef that after prohibition time one may not put vessel in water before boiling even if leaves there until boils — I abbreviated since Terumat HaDeshen siman 138 and Agur wrote their wording: custom is when inserting one vessel water ceases boiling — therefore wait in each vessel until water bubbles; up to here; and one must warn kasherers, for they practice great lightness and kasher quickly one after another without checking if boiling rises; and one may learn merit for them, for way of kashering is only spoons and bowls used by irui where hagalah in water at yad soledes bo alone helps; proof from poskim of Maharai siman 151 wrote regarding matter sufficient with hagalah by irui — this hagalah also helps; already explained siman 451 seif 5 that vessels mentioned above are kashered by irui; nevertheless in copper pots and things used via kli rishon it appears to me from Terumat HaDeshen that even b'dieved this hagalah does not help at all — not as appears from responsum of Rashal siman 26.
eshel-avraham/1:ג: To libun — Peri Chadash wrote thus per his view that noten taam lifgam forbidden and prohibition in any amount; and for those who permit one may kasher after vessel is not ben yomo; and he concluded nevertheless one may not kasher while twenty-four hours passed, for noten taam lifgam permitted only b'dieved.
eshel-avraham/2:_: Unless — and we did not decree lest ben yomo because there if cooking in ben yomo pot it is forbidden d'oraisa; and also in house of frequent use we fear mistake — not so here even if one ben yomo it absorbs only slightly and is noten taam bar noten taam; also one coming to kasher why would he err — Kaf HaChayyim in name of Rosh. And Mechaber wrote together — same one after another without sixty in water against all vessels; see Yoreh De'ah siman 99 seif 6; and Peri Chadash not as Raavad who holds first nullified and second does not return and reawaken — see there.
kaf-hachayyim/2:_: (2) Regarding how long vessel stays in pot when kashering — Rif wrote chapter Kol HaShaah that one leaves them inside until they expel; and Ran there; and Rambam chapter 5 halacha 23; and Raavad in Sefer Tamid siman 25; and Rashba in Terumat HaDeshen house 4 gate 4; and Radbaz compelled in Rambam wording siman 141 — see there. But Tur wrote practice is to insert and remove immediately; and Tur Yoreh De'ah siman 121 — see there; and Mordechai chapter Kol HaShaah siman 479 and Beit David Beit Yosef; and Levush seif 2; and Peri Chadash at end seif 6 wrote custom of Israel is Torah. However Taz s.k. 2 wrote Tur's words insert and remove immediately appears not literal immediately but at least some waiting; and wrote so in Kol Bo one must be precise not to hurry removing vessel from pot so there is time for boiling to enter and expel what was absorbed; and so Orach Chayyim 1, Responsa 7, Orach Chayyim 4, Ben Aharon chapter 96, Orach Chayyim 12; and see below Orach Chayyim 14.
kaf-hachayyim/3:_: (3) Question to those who hold we do not nullify prohibition l'chatchila — how did Torah permit kashering vessel via hagalah while nullifying prohibition absorbed in them l'chatchila in water one kasher them? Rather certainly they said no nullifying prohibition only when intending to mix prohibition in heter to enjoy it; but intending to kasher vessel and not enjoying prohibition — permitted. Ran chapter Ein Maamidin.
kaf-hachayyim/4:_: (4) There — before fifth hour — for then noten taam bar noten taam d'heter ben yomo Taz s.k. 1. And how is noten taam bar noten taam d'heter: chametz gives taste to vessel, vessel to water, water returns and gives taste to bowl — yet chametz prohibition not yet arrived. Mordechai chapter Kol HaShaah siman 476. Levush seif 3. And even though some say chametz since named on it is called prohibition taste and our master zl above siman 451 seif 4 concerned for their view — nevertheless here he relied on lenient views because anyway there is some view permitting all these matters. Maamar Mordechai Orach Chayyim 1. And see above siman 451 Orach Chayyim 39.
kaf-hachayyim/5:_: (5) There — before fifth hour — meaning beginning of fifth hour end of fourth hour, since from fourth hour forbidden in any case d'rabbanan (as above siman 443) — not called noten taam bar noten taam d'heter. Peri Chadash. Mateh Yehuda. Machatzit HaShekel Orach Chayyim 1. Nehar Shalom Orach Chayyim 1. Responsa 7 Orach Chayyim 8. Chayei Adam klal 125 Orach Chayyim 33.
kaf-hachayyim/6:_: (6) There — so that one need not etc. — meaning then one need not be careful vessel not ben yomo, for even if ben yomo and no sixty against vessels — permitted since still permitted time and it is noten taam bar noten taam d'heter. Tosafot Chullin 108b and Avodah Zarah 76a. And Rosh end of Avodah Zarah and chapter Kol HaShaah. And Mordechai chapter Kol HaShaah and Ran end chapter Kol HaBasar. And Beit David Tur and Beit Yosef. And Or U'Mussar Orach Chayyim 1. Magen Avraham s.k. 1. Chayei Adam Orach Chayyim 2. Chokhmat Yosef Orach Chayyim 1. Machatzit HaShekel Orach Chayyim 2. Responsa 7 Orach Chayyim 13. Chayei Adam there Orach Chayyim 33; and even though above siman 447 seif 5 hagahah forbids things cooked in chametz vessel and did not permit from noten taam bar noten taam — one may say here since many taste transfers from food to vessel and vessel to water and water to vessel — permitted. Magen Avraham there. Chayei Adam there. Machatzit HaShekel there. All per law; but custom not to kasher any ben yomo vessel as below seif 2 hagahah — see there. And see also below Orach Chayyim 21 regarding pot one kasher in whether need kasher it first — see there.
kaf-hachayyim/7:_: (7) Incident where bread piece found in pot they were kashering — asked if need re-kasher vessels; Pri Megadim brought Raavad siman 195: for those who hold not chatzitzah — obvious not vessels, for bread taste expelled in water nullified in sixty; and for those who hold chatzitzah also no need re-kasher vessels, for we did not see they accepted chatzitzah except in substance not taste; and even though practice to kasher kneading vessels of lenient etc. — that is l'chatchila etc.; and since it is custom we do not add stringency; however if found clearly their custom forbids even b'dieved by taste alone — then certainly must re-kasher these vessels — Pri Megadim see there. Zachor L'Chaim end siman 451. And see above siman 447 Orach Chayyim 59 and Orach Chayyim 76.
levushei-serad/1:_: For Rabbeinu Yehuda also all explicitly agree in Beit Yosef in this siman in name of Geonim and Talmidei Chachamim without any disputant that boiling helps only when it raises boiling — see Peri Chadash here; and Mechaber siman 451 seif 63 regarding knives kashered in kli rishon even not at fire suffices when yad soledes bo as Magen Avraham s.k. 7 there — must be because primary use of knives is kli rishon even though sometimes also kli rishon — he held zl siman 451 we follow any vessel by majority use — therefore from complete law suffices to kasher in kli rishon; and in Gemara also stam in boiling; but nevertheless stringent on knife because much adheres and requires kli rishon; and in any case does not require raising boiling — see Chayei Adam s.k. 7; but vessel whose use is kli rishon and requires hagalah by law must raise boiling — so must be; not as I saw someone confused here with knife law above; however for law per what we hold solid item law is kli rishon all time it is yad soledes bo as Acharonim Yoreh De'ah siman 34 and Magen Avraham siman 447 s.k. 9 — therefore knives cutting hot solid items — their law as all things used in kli rishon and must raise boiling and does not suffice otherwise — examine well.
levushei-serad/2:_: Sixty against vessel one kasher — also helps for one who kasher as should be.
netiv-chayim/1:_: If vessels ben yomo but before fifth hour — even so as should be.
netiv-chayim/2:_: Or at end — Mishna Berurah: since before fifth hour and hagalah once suffices if wants to use pot on Pesach; but after fifth hour if boiling ceased it absorbed — must kasher first and last as Rosh and Tur.
netiv-chayim/3:_: Rather chametz taste — not chatzitzah in this view I do not recognize; there wheat taste in something; not so in our case taste is sensed — we say it returns and reawakens; why then say afterward boil boiling water without measure — at beginning also could give boiling without measure; if so when full even finger or two less — water are sixty against it as we say against its lip; and one may say we do not nullify prohibition l'chatchila — then regarding lip also concern lest boiling sparks ascend on lip not on first spark place and return to water; and you wrote nullified in sixty — we do not nullify prohibition l'chatchila; and see views of Geonim — there will be third view that explanation how she kashered does not refer to first hagalah when wanting to kasher in it — for him no lip needed — requires study.
rabbi-akiva-eiger/1:_: Rama words puzzling — also in my humble opinion Rama explained what Mechaber wrote; and if leaves etc.; and so that one need not be careful water not cease boiling — meaning in one of these suffices generally, or careful to leave until expulsion finishes in narrowing and no more since busy expelling does not absorb, or careful to remove vessels while water not ceased boiling — then what water absorbed did not expel; but before fifth hour may leave them much even if cease boiling; and since we say after prohibition time one of them helps; and meaning not leaving too much except in narrowing until expulsion finishes — in this permitted even if cease boiling; if so automatically water not boiling entire hagalah time since did not leave except until expulsion finished; and if ceased boiling moment before — at time of finishing expulsion water not boiling; if so proven hagalah helps even if water not boiling; and if so Rama wrote well however many dispute — examine well.
rabbi-akiva-eiger/2:_: All the time they are boiling they did not absorb from hagalah water — meaning regarding water: while absorbing they do not expel — what absorbs in this boiling does not expel in this boiling; but absorption already expelled as explained in Tosafot; and if they cease boiling even if boil again — nevertheless at time of boiling they absorb in vessel what absorbed when ceased; since did not absorb in this boiling it is like old absorption — examine well.
rabbi-akiva-eiger/4:_: Not as one who asked — in my humble opinion even per those who say taste returns and reawakens — here permitted since at time of hagalah before Pesach water was permitted; automatically second taste in heter; and there are three tastes in heter; and permitted as kashering before fifth hour; and better than before fifth hour not certain noten taam bar noten taam heter since chametz named on it; but here heter from nullification in sixty — called noten taam bar noten taam d'heter even in milk and blood — see Yoreh De'ah siman 103; if so no chatzitzah; and reason to discuss Rashba kashering two vessels one after another without sixty against both — we say chatzitzah; for though in prohibition visible mixture we say chatzitzah; but in vessels expulsion when kashered vessel A and there was sixty — called noten taam bar noten taam d'heter; and when kashered vessel B first expulsion not joined since already permitted from noten taam bar noten taam d'heter and prohibition cannot apply there — except per those who hold in cooking second taste in heter does not help; but here many tastes and two vessels — when kashering two vessels one after another water forbidden while expulsion still in water — noten taam bar noten taam d'heter does not help in water; permitted only from nullification in sixty; and again we say chatzitzah — examine well.
rabbi-akiva-eiger/5:_: If they touch one another — requires study: what of it that at contact place boiling did not reach — water enters inside vessel and need not be on vessel walls except vessels that draw boiling from them — see seif 5.
rabbi-akiva-eiger/6:_: In Tiberias waters one kasher in them — this is not novel; rather Orach Chayyim wrote if forbidden in Tiberias waters and things appear possible to kasher via hot water in kli rishon — hagalah via fire kashering helps for all — end of his words; explained novelty that can kasher even via hot water and we do not say need hagalah water specifically in Tiberias as it absorbs so it expels; and in Beit Yosef: one may kasher in them or in hot-spring waters.
yad-ephraim/1:_: Taz s.k. 11 implies where pot enters chametz it does not help kasher etc. — so too it forbids etc.; and this does not interrupt vessels he kasher on erev Pesach etc. as should be.
